headline: Approved July 9 meeting minutes; Governance Committee recommended three 3-year trustee terms; Strategic Plan Review postponed.
summary: The meeting covered the Library Director's report on record July usage and a new Vermont library law. Members approved the July 9 minutes unanimously. The Governance Committee recommended three 3-year terms for trustees, and the Strategic Plan Review was postponed.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the July 9, 2026 meeting by unanimous vote.
Governance Committee recommended three 3-year trustee terms, with the option of returning after one year.
Postponed the Strategic Plan Review to a smaller subcommittee.

decision_evidence.quote: Upon a motion made by Trustee Anne LaLonder and seconded by Trustee Stacey Pape, the Trustees voted unanimously to accept the minutes of the July 9, 2026 Board of Trustees Meeting.
Based on a review of Board of Trustee Bylaws from neighboring communities, the Governance Committee recommended three 3-year terms with the option of returning after one year.
The Strategic Plan Review was postponed, to be addressed by a smaller subcommittee focused on finalizing the plan.
